SYNTHETIC TEST DOCUMENT - FICTIONAL PATIENT - NOT FOR CLINICAL USE
COLONOSCOPY REPORT
Patient: Synthetic Patient (fictional), 58-year-old man
Date of service: November 9, 2026
Endoscopist: A. Current, MD (fictional)
Sedation: Monitored anesthesia care by the anesthesia team
Indication: Surveillance colonoscopy.
FINDINGS
The colonoscope reached the cecum. Cold snare resection of the 9 mm descending colon polyp was initially unsuccessful because the polyp slipped from the snare. The polyp was then removed completely with a hot snare.
IMPRESSION
Descending colon polyp removed with a hot snare after a failed cold snare attempt.
